note: BLM campground on the open sagebrush bench beside the Green River, 20 mi N of Pinedale on US-191; the access road leaves the highway immediately south of the Green River bridge, so slow early. The Warren Bridge River Access Area lies upstream. --Claude
summary: BLM page + 2023 BLM release: 16 pull-through sites + 6 picnic sites, water at each site, vault toilets, RV dump ($5), $10/night (2023 figure), FCFS (RIDB info-only listing). Riverview kept: camping loop ~90-130 m from the Green River over open sagebrush. Pin OK.
flags: Waterfront 'riverview' kept: the star-shaped camping loop's NW pull-throughs (about 43.0160,-110.1225) are ~90-130 m from the Green River's bank over open sagebrush, with a thin willow fringe at the bank; the river is ~45 m wide. The closer north loop (~60 m from the bank) looks like the day-use/picnic area. No site within ~50 m.
Fees: the only BLM fee figure is the 2023 release ($10, dump $5); the current BLM page gives none. Stored $10 kept with checked 2023. A camper site reports a $5 senior-pass rate (not BLM).
Season: BLM gives no season dates (the 2023 release says the campground opened for summer by May 26) - season not written.
Phone: empty -> 307-367-5300 (BLM Pinedale Field Office, on the campground page).
Pin 43.01649,-110.12020 is ~110 m from the camping loop centre (about 43.0158,-110.1213) - no move. Website current; no recreation.gov booking listing exists.
